signal: PerformYard raised $95M to scale its AI-driven performance management platform after years of bootstrapping.

email.body1:
Mark, saw PerformYard raised $95M to scale the platform after years of running lean.

Scaling that fast usually means more accounts in play than the BD team can work before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for PerformYard off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mark, quick follow-up for PerformYard.

Post-raise, expectations on pipeline tend to jump faster than the BD team can grow. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PerformYard needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mark, last bit of proof for PerformYard.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PerformYard's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mark, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a raise, timing is everything, and the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a growth-stage BD motion? I'll tailor it to PerformYard either way.
